gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-inder: Cut-out stencil swagger, with tall lowercase and wide gaps between the bridges. Inder follows in quiet, tidy letters where capitals and lowercase sit close in height, so the loud heading gets room to talk.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-jaldi: Jaldi is brushed-looking and compact, with a lofty x-height. Snowburst One stays loud above it, while the sans-serif text beneath runs tight and dark, its gaping c giving a long stretch of reading a steady, friendly texture.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-kdam-thmor-pro: Modern, with a stencil punch up top and rounded weight below. Snowburst One cuts bold, gapped shapes against Kdam Thmor Pro, a sans-serif whose bowls fill the line, and that mix of cut-out and full-bodied is what holds the eye.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-krona-one: Approachable, despite the stencil bravado overhead. Krona One spreads its loosely spaced sans-serif letters out with lowercase as sturdy as cast iron capitals, so a long passage moves along slowly and with some heft.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-magra: Snowburst One brings stencil boldness, its bridges wide and its lowercase built tall. And Magra handles the steady work, a sans with a big-bodied feel in every lowercase word, so the heading shouts while the text simply gets on with it.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-major-mono-displ: Precise, even when the heading is shouting in stencil cuts. And the real draw is the gap between Snowburst One's low-contrast cut shapes and Major Mono Display, a monospace whose neon-tube strokes sweep open with generous sidebearings.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-martian-mono: Martian Mono lays out fixed-width, code-style monospace letters with loose spacing and open curves. But Snowburst One is the one with attitude, its stencil bridges and tall lowercase heavy where the ballpoint-thin body stroke stays light.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-matemasie: Stencil cut-outs meet tidy round forms, with Snowburst One's open shapes leading over Matemasie's closed ones. The strongest thing here is that clash of open and closed.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-mitr: Snowburst One is all stencil bridges and tall lowercase. Mitr, a sans-serif with almost no gap between its x-height and cap height, does the compact, sturdy work, while the heading carries the show-off cuts.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-momo-trust-displ: Stencil-cut and bold, with an unexpectedly tall lowercase. Momo Trust Display brings a plain sans with drifting, far-apart letters and a generous x-height, and that spacious body against the sharp heading is the pair's best trick.
